name: catwalk-walk
intent: A stylized looping catwalk locomotion: the character walks outward with pronounced hip sway, performs a broad presentation U-turn into a rear-facing return walk, then executes a tight pivot back to front and settles into the opening pose.

keyPoses.role: catwalk step with a lateral hip-sway accent
held presentation pose during the U-turn
front-facing alignment during the fast pivot
loop closure with the opening pose restored

weightTransfer: During the catwalk strides, the pelvis shifts laterally in an alternating pattern. Hips X is +0.467 MLL at f84, -0.436 MLL at f94, +0.602 MLL at f117, and -0.654 MLL at f129, showing alternating right/left pelvis displacement. Support-foot identity is not asserted because animation.json has no explicit foot-contact events.
bodyMechanics: Catwalk strides combine lateral pelvis motion with alternating axial rotation of the spine and chest. The first direction change is a broad translated U-turn with a presentation hold (f149→f240: about 18.78 MLL of pelvis travel and +185.7° of heading change). The second is a tight near-in-place pivot before the front-facing settle (f371→f405: about 1.13 MLL of pelvis travel and +169.2° of heading change).

recommended: stylized catwalk/runway locomotion with pronounced hip sway
showcase direction-change choreography contrasting a broad U-turn with a tight pivot
looped locomotion that changes heading and returns to the opening pose
